cards.name: Cornered Orc
cards.text: Forced: After Cornered Orc engages a player, it makes an immediate attack.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if the defending character is damaged).

cards.name: Search the Ruins
cards.text:
Surge.
Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, raise each player's threat by 2.  Response: After Search the Ruins is defeated, reduce each player's threat by 3.

cards.name: Find Shelter
cards.text:
Surge. Time 4.
Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this quest card, each player deals 4 damage to a hero he controls. Then, place 4 time counters on this quest card.

cards.name: Hunting the Orcs
cards.text: Forced: After an enemy is defeated, place 1 resource token here. Then if there are at least X resource tokens here, flip Hunting the Orcs and place each resource token here on Savage Counterattack. After that, advance to stage 2. X is 3 more than the number of players in the game.
cards.back_text: Forced: After Savage Counter-attack enters play, advance to stage 2A.  Forced: After an enemy attacks and destroys a character, discard 1 resource token here.  If there are no resource tokens here, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Exposed Ridge
cards.text: While Exposed Ridge is the active location, it gains: "Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, each player deals 1 damage to a character he controls."
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each damaged character the defending player controls.

cards.name: Ice Storm
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player assigns X damage among characters he controls, where X is the number of quest cards in play. Then, exhaust each damaged character.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Assign X damage among characters you control. X is the number of quest cards in play.

cards.name: Make Camp
cards.text:
Surge.
Characters cannot be healed.  Response: After Make Camp is defeated, each player heals up to 3 damage from a hero he controls.

cards.name: Ruins of Arnor
cards.text: Forced: After the "when revealed" effect of a treachery card is canceled, raise each player's threat by 2.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, the defending player raises his threat by 2.

cards.name: Sheltered Valley
cards.text: While Sheltered Valley is the active location, it gains: "Response: When Sheltered Valley is explored, heal all damage from 1 character."   Travel: Remove 1 resource token from the Mission objective.

cards.name: Weathered Hilltop
cards.text:
Weathered Hilltop gets +1 [threat] for each resource token on it.
Forced: After a Weather treachery is revealed from the encounter deck, place 1 resource token here.

cards.name: Biting Wind
cards.text: When Revealed: Assign X damage among characters committed to the quest. X is the number of characters committed to the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character.

cards.name: Concealed Orc-camp
cards.text: While Concealed Orc-camp is the active location, it gains: "Response: When Concealed Orc-camp is explored, place 1 resource token on the Mission objective."   Travel: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Orc enemy and puts it into play engaged with him. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Scattered Among the Hills
cards.text: Setup: Set Orc Ambush and Amon Ford aside, out of play. Create the Orc deck (see insert) and set it next to the quest deck. Make Exposed Ridge the active location. Add Hunting the Orcs and 1 Weathered Hilltop to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: The first Weather treachery revealed each round gains surge.  Forced: After the active location is explored, reveal the top card of the Orc deck and resolve its staging as if it was just revealed from the encounter deck (the top 2 cards instead if there are 3 or more players in the game).

cards.name: Cornered Animals
cards.text: When Revealed: End the current phase. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the Orc deck into the encounter deck. Reveal Orc Ambush and Amon Ford and add them to the staging area.
cards.back_text: Each damaged character gets -1 [willpower].  Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, either discard 1 resource token from Savage Counter-attack, or reveal an additional encounter card this phase.  If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

cards.name: Angmar Orc
cards.text: When Revealed: Either discard 1 ally from play, or reveal an additional encounter card.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys an ally, return attacking enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Cold from Angmar
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player deals 1 damage to a hero he controls. Then, attach Cold from Angmar to the current quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Treat each damaged character's printed text box as if it were blank, except for keywords and Traits.")

cards.name: Angmar Marauder
cards.text: Forced: After Angmar Marauder attacks and destroys an ally, return it to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each ally the defending player controls.

cards.name: Freezing Blast
cards.text:
Doomed 2.
When Revealed: Remove each damaged character from the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each damaged character the defending player controls.

cards.name: Angmar Captain
cards.text: Forced: After Angmar Captain attacks and destroys an ally, discard the top card of the defending player's deck. If the discarded card is an ally, Angmar Captain makes an additional attack against the defending player.

cards.name: Orc Ambush
cards.text:
Each Orc enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
When Revealed: Each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Orc enemy and put it into play engaged with him. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Amon Forn
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
While Amon Forn is the active location, it gains: "Forced: After an Orc enemy is added to the staging area, it makes an immediate attack against the first player." The players cannot win while Amon Forn is in play.

cards.name: Tragic Discovery
cards.text: When Revealed: Raise each player's threat by the [threat] of the active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player either raises his threat by 3, or this attack is considered undefended.

cards.name: Ancient Causeway
cards.text: Forced: When Ancient Causeway is explored, raise each player's threat by 2.
